item.title: India: National Technology Readiness Assessment Framework
item.description: India has launched the National Technology Readiness Assessment Framework (NTRAF) to standardise the evaluation of technology projects and support the transition from research to market-ready innovation.

item.title: Hong Kong: Electronic Records to Modernise Digital Trade
item.description: Hong Kong has officially launched a public consultation on a legislative framework to digitalise business-to-business trade documents, aiming to modernise cross-border commerce and align with global standards.

item.title: Vietnam: National Data Centre No.1 Drives Digital Transformation
item.description: Vietnam’s National Data Centre No.1 is strengthening secure, integrated data infrastructure to accelerate digital transformation, improve public services and support data-driven governance and innovation.

item.title: Thailand: NSTDA’s Magik Greenhouse Powers Smart Farming
item.description: NSTDA, through EECi, is scaling up its smart Magik Greenhouse technology in Thailand, using red-light-optimised materials and automated systems to significantly boost crop quality, yield and sustainability.

item.title: Indonesia: Preparing Its Workforce for Industry 4.0 and Digitalisation
item.description: Indonesia’s Ministry of Industry is accelerating national industrialisation by developing a skilled, technologically adept and entrepreneurial workforce aligned with Industry 4.0 and the Astacita vision.

item.title: Malaysia: Selangor AI Pilot to Boost Early Childhood Development
item.description: Selangor’s AI-driven early childhood screening programme uses digital tools to quickly identify developmental delays, enhance access and support timely interventions for better long-term outcomes.

item.title: Vietnam Achieves Breakthrough with 5G Advanced Trial
item.description: Viettel’s successful 5G Advanced trial in Vietnam achieves ultra-fast speeds and reliable connectivity, marking a major step in the country’s digital transformation and next-generation network rollout across the nation.

item.title: Hong Kong: HKUST’s Smart Approach Advances Coral Research
item.description: HKUST researchers used cutting-edge digital and computational tools to map deep-sea coral-microbe interactions, providing insights for broader marine biology research and biotechnology applications.

item.title: The Philippines: Digital Tools Empower Consumers, Businesses
item.description: DTI is leveraging digital tools to educate consumers, enhance online transaction safety and fully empower women-led MSMEs, fostering a stronger, more informed and digitally enabled Philippine economy nationwide.

item.title: Singapore: Insights into Early Screen Exposure and Development
item.description: A long-term Singapore study shows that screen exposure in the first two years of life is linked to lasting changes in brain development, while active parental engagement, such as reading, can help support healthier outcomes.
